title: Articles of impeachment filed against Defense Secretary Hegseth; Trump and Rubio defend him
detail: A US congressman filed a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio publicly defended him.

title: Trump administration imposes tariffs above 100% on Indian solar panels
detail: The Trump administration imposed tariffs topping 100 percent on solar panels imported from India, per a Google News-aggregated report. Original outlet not identified; details unverified.
